youtube.title: You never pressed the 14th floor 🛗 #Shorts
youtube.description: Press fourteen in a hotel elevator and you are not going to the fourteenth floor. Most of us never notice, because we are busy staring at our phones. The real thirteenth floor is still there. Some buildings hide it as a machine floor full of pipes and pumps, some call it twelve A, and most just skip the number and hope you never count. The label changed, but the building did not. Full episode on the channel. #Shorts #hotels #elevator #unlucky13 #facts #thehiddenwhy

instagram.caption: You pressed fourteen. But that floor is really the thirteenth, just wearing a different number. Some buildings hide it as a machine floor, some call it 12A, most just skip the label and hope you never count. Next time, count the floors. #thehiddenwhy #hotels #elevator #didyouknow
